mods.name: The Stalker
mods.description: One persistent hunter haunts your world. Kill it and it comes back stronger — and it learns: counter it with arrows, it shrugs off arrows; hide behind walls, it starts breaking them; it even patrols the places you visit most. It steals your best loot when it kills you; kill it to take everything back. Defeat the Apex tier to win. Singleplayer challenge mod for streaming.
